referenceRole: Original approved engravings used as editing targets. One immediately readable surreal metaphor per scene; red carries the meaning.

prompts.name: observer
prompts.prompt: Use case: compositing. Make a meaning-first surreal engraving for Reporta based on the supplied woman-with-newspaper image. Preserve the same recognizable woman, wavy hair, serious dry expression, fine nineteenth-century copperplate hatching and neutral almost-white paper. ONE immediately understood idea: MUCH NEWS IN, ONE SELECTED NEWSPAPER OUT. Recompose square image as a beautifully engraved waist-up woman at LEFT, holding the long handle of an oversized ordinary wire kitchen sieve at CENTER-RIGHT. A lively dense storm of many tiny monochrome newspaper sheets falls from top right into the sieve. The mesh is rendered clearly as real fine mesh with a thick circular rim. Under the sieve emerges exactly ONE crisp neatly folded VERMILION-RED newspaper, floating gently into the woman's other open hand below it. Both hands anatomically correct, only two hands. The selected newspaper must be large, instantly recognizable with sparse black engraved column marks, no letters. This red newspaper is the ONLY red object. Flow is top to bottom, clear visual hierarchy: a large cloud of many black papers, sieve, one red paper; no diagram arrows or labels. The impossible scale of the sieve and orderly selected newspaper supply the fantasy. Leave clear white negative space behind the red paper so it reads at thumbnail size. Keep face visible and pleasantly knowing. No newspaper she is already reading, no staircase, no sofa, no extra people, no decorative symbols. Palette exclusively deep black print, near-white neutral paper and flat vermilion #F04A32. Very fine tapered crosshatching and etched highlights, no gray airbrush, no gradients, no sepia, no childish cartoon style. Square composition, all main objects within margins, readable central silhouette. No text, logos, watermark or brand mascot. This should communicate selection and relief from information overload in a single glance without a caption.

prompts.name: attention
prompts.prompt: Use case: compositing. Rework the provided hand-and-magnifying-glass copperplate engraving for Reporta with ONE simple visual metaphor: FIND SOMETHING VALUABLE IN A SEA OF PRINT. Preserve the diagonal composition, anatomical hand, circular black magnifier, fan of newspapers, masterful dense curved black crosshatching and almost-white neutral paper. Inside the magnifying lens, a single large brilliant-cut VERMILION RED gemstone emerges physically out of a clean tear in the newspaper. The stone is unmistakably a precious faceted gem, solid red with fine black engraved facet lines and pale highlights, no rainbow or sparkle icons. It fills about two thirds of the lens so it is instantly readable at thumbnail scale. The top point protrudes in front of the lens rim: impossible, tactile, not a flat picture printed on the page. Around it many dense mundane black newspaper columns continue OUTSIDE the lens. A narrow red printed line from the newspaper feeds into the base of the gem through the torn opening, integrating the brand-red accent with the story. All else black ink and paper, only one red focal object. No office, flames, furniture, faces, second narrative, captions or symbols. Sculptural hand and beautiful detailed etched shadows; clear silhouette, lots of quiet paper around the main objects. Square composition with generous margins. Strict palette black, neutral off-white and #F04A32 red. No gradients, gray airbrush, watercolor, sepia, neon, decorative bokeh or clipart. No readable text, no logo, no mascot, no watermark. Sophisticated surreal print but immediately obvious meaning without explanatory text.

prompts.name: city
prompts.prompt: Use case: compositing. Use the supplied city engraving as architectural and linework source for a new simple surreal Reporta editorial image. ONE instantly understood concept: AN ENTIRE WORLD IN YOUR MORNING CUP. The entire richly detailed black-and-white city, with miniature masonry buildings, one tower, streets and antennas, is now contained INSIDE ONE ordinary porcelain coffee cup and its saucer on a plain tabletop. The city rises from inside the cup like a miniature living landscape; the cup rim and handle must be completely visible, city physically rooted in the cup, not floating separately. No outside full-size city skyline. A single wide VERMILION RED ribbon flows down from between the miniature city buildings, passes over the front lip of the cup, weaves through its handle then rests on the tabletop in a clean gentle curve. The ribbon unifies the selected stories, and is the ONLY color. Everything else meticulously engraved black ink on neutral near-white paper, dense tapered copperplate crosshatching, sculptural ceramic with convincing curved hatch strokes, finely detailed tiny buildings. Bold clear cup silhouette; no florid ornamental cup pattern competing with the city. Strong fantastic scale contrast, calm witty morning atmosphere, not a fantasy collage. Landscape 3:2 composition. Cup and city centered in the middle 60 percent of frame, main group fills 75 percent of image height; generous paper margin on all sides and above, no objects cropped. Meaning should be clear in a small thumbnail. No floating buildings, stairways, second subplot, people with giant heads, labels, decorative stars, glow, other colors, sepia or gray airbrush. No readable text, logos, brand mascot or watermarks. Exhibition-quality editorial engraving, smart rather than cute.

prompts.name: photo
prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Original landscape 3:2 editorial photograph used only as a labelled art-direction sample in the Reporta news brand book. A candid adult reader in a plain light cotton shirt, seated at a metal cafe table outdoors, unfolding a broadsheet newspaper; the newspaper, hands and face all sharp and clearly visible. Sidewalk cafe in a contemporary city, masonry facade with an honest real texture. Compose reader on right third, quiet pale wall on left third suitable for a small brand mark overlay. Eye-level 50mm documentary frame, natural soft daylight, subtle film grain. Black and white silver gelatin tonal quality, high clarity, open shadows, no artificial blur, no gritty heavy filter. Relaxed absorbed expression, no posing for camera, no dramatic lighting, no objects in front of face. No readable newspaper headlines, no brands, no logos, no snake or worm, no watermark. Landscape 1536x1024.
